title: New Aircrafts & Stunning Liveries in MSFS2020 Marketplace! ✈️✨ | Weekly Update | week 38
description:
🔍 Description
🚀Check out this week’s updates in the Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace and take your flying adventures to new heights. After a brief pause, the onboarding of aircraft from MSFS 2024 has resumed, with three new aircraft backported: the Cessna 404 Titan, the Jetson One, and the Joby S4. Additionally, new 767 variants from MScenery have been added, along with a livery pack for Captain Sim’s 777-200LR. Be sure to like, comment, and explore more exciting Microsoft Flight content!🌍🛫

📹 Other marketplace additions
If you are looking for either the new training missions or new enhanced scenery and enhanced airports review the respective video by clicking on one if the links below:

- New activities: https://youtu.be/IB9mESriMOA
